Action: A branch of a overseas bank operating in the UAE has been fined Dh20 million for breaking UAE anti-money laundering rules – one of the biggest penalties imposed so far. The UAE Central Bank said there had been ‘significant, repeated failures’ of its Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) and Illegal Organisations and Sanctions framework. It imposed an additional Dh300,000 fine on the branch’s head of compliance and money laundering reporting office.
